Anne-Kirstine Dyrvig is an epidemiologist based in Department 1 (Afdeling 1) at the RKKP's Videncenter (the Knowledge Center for the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme) [^src1]. She serves as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]], the governing steering committee for the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) [^src1]. 

In her capacity on the steering committee, Dyrvig provides essential epidemiological and methodological support for the database's data collection and analysis efforts. Her involvement is part of the interdisciplinary and cross-regional governance structure detailed in the AKDB's 2023 annual report. This committee oversees the database's clinical indicators and addresses operational challenges—such as technical registration errors in systems like SMR and SFI, coding practices, and wait-time measurement issues—across Denmark's five regions [^src1].
